Skeleton for RQ3: *how much do the microtexts resemble contemporary social
media content? (Can an LLM be fooled into thinking the microtexts are UGC?)*

This is a structural placeholder, mirroring `rq1-sentiment.Rmd`. The
underlying analysis functions (`analyse_ugc_ollama()`, `run_ugc_pipeline()`
in `R/ugc.R`) aren't implemented yet — including the `social_media_text_type`
structured type, whose `label`/`score` fields are still `"???"` placeholders.
